fairness.problem: Continuously ready EffectAdmission messages plus synchronous authority reads can occupy a complete cooperative scheduling budget on the current-thread Runtime, starving the signal watcher.
fairness.experiment: A fixture-only100ms synchronous validator delay keeps both real blocking workers in the same ready authorization path; OS signal registration, signal sender, watcher and original8-second command-exit bound unchanged. Real native public SIGINT test fails before the fix and passes after, without relaxing its assertion.
